farraa:1-1.t:
His words, Mighty and Majestic is He: ﴿إِنَّآ أَعْطَيْنَاكَ ٱلْكَوْثَرَ﴾.
Ibn ʿAbbās said: It is abundant good, and the Qur'an is part of it.
[Abū al-ʿAbbās narrated to us; he said: Muḥammad narrated to us; he said:] al-Farrāʾ narrated to us; he said: Mindal ibn ʿAlī al-ʿAnazī narrated to me, with a chain of transmission going back to ʿĀʾisha; he said: "الكوثر" is a river in Paradise; whoever would like to hear its sound, let him put his two fingers in his ears.

farraa:2-2.t:
His words, Mighty and Majestic is He: ﴿فَصَلِّ لِرَبِّكَ وَٱنْحَرْ﴾.
It is said: pray to your Lord on the day of the ʿĪd, then sacrifice.
[Abū al-ʿAbbās narrated to us; he said: Muḥammad narrated to us; he said:] al-Farrāʾ narrated to us; he said: Qays narrated to me from Yazīd ibn Yazīd ibn Jābir, from a man, from ʿAlī, who said concerning it: «النحر» is your holding your left hand with your right in prayer. And he said: ﴿فَصَلِّ لِرَبِّكَ وَٱنْحَرْ﴾: face the qibla with your upper chest (نحر). And I heard one of the Arabs say: منازلنا تتناحر (our dwellings face one another): this one with its front (نحر) to that one, i.e. opposite it. One of Banū Asad recited to me:
أبا حَكَم ها أنت عَمُّ مُجالِدٍ * وسيِّدُ أهلِ الأَبْطَحِ المتناحرِ
(O Abū Ḥakam, here you are, the uncle of Mujālid and the master of the people of al-Abṭaḥ, whose [dwellings] face one another.)
This is of that kind: parts of it face (ينحر) one another.

farraa:3-3.t:
His words, Mighty and Majestic is He: ﴿إِنَّ شَانِئَكَ هُوَ ٱلأَبْتَرُ﴾.
They used to call a man who had no male child «أبتر» (cut off) [150/b], i.e.: he dies and leaves no remembrance. Some of Quraysh said it of the Prophet ﷺ, so Allah, Blessed and Exalted is He, said: ﴿إِنَّ شَانِئَكَ﴾ — the one who hates you and is your enemy — is the «أبتر», who has no remembrance for any good deed; as for you, I have made your mention together with My mention. That is His word: ﴿وَرَفَعْنَا لَكَ ذِكْرَكَ﴾.
